title: Kuraswa kweMhuru Yegoridhe
intro: Munhu anotaurwa muKorani akatungamira vanhu vazhinji mukutsauka panguva yekushaikwa kwemuporofita ane chiremera. Chimwe chinhu chakagadzirwa negoridhe chakabata mwoyo yerudzi rwese - asi nyaya yemunhu uyu inoguma nekusurukirwa uye kutukwa kusinganzwisisike. Ndiani angava mudzingwa uyu?
clues: Ndakabuda panguva iyo muporofita mukuru akanga asipo uyo akanga akwira kudenga kuti awane nhungamiro yaMwari.
Ndakakonzera kuti vanhu vazhinji vatsauke nechimwe chinhu chandakaita nemaoko angu.
Chisikwa chegoridhe chandakaita chaiita sechine hupenyu, chichiburitsa manzwi aishamisa avo vaichitevera.
Ndakati ndakaona zvisingaonekwe nevamwe — kuona zvisingaonekwe.
Ndakatora chimwe chinhu kubva pamakwara emutumwa waMwari ndikachikanda musimbi yakanyungudutswa.
Ndakatongerwa kufamba-famba ndega, ndichitukwa kuti hapana aigona kubata ganda rangu kana kuti ini ndikabata ravo.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Kudzingwa, kurambidzwa kubatwa kana kubata vamwe
Akapiswa ari mupenyu nekuda kwekuramba kutenda
outcome.answer: Kudzingwa, kurambidzwa kubatwa kana kubata vamwe

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
